svg.title: Figure 3 Calibration
svg.desc: Calibration plots compare observed wall-thickness flag fractions with mean predicted probabilities in validation deciles for each reference and joint-factor model. Curves deviate from the ideal diagonal; they are descriptive and do not show new validation recalibration.
